Key pain: when they enable JSON mode + streaming + function_schema, sometimes the returned stream contains partial tokens that break the parser at the edge of chunk boundaries. They reported two behaviors: (1) full response arrives but final chunk contains "null" or truncated array element; (2) API returns generic 400-ish schema validation error with no field-level detail.
